item.title: He Posted His Plan Online Before Killing Three Coworkers
item.description: Randy Stair, 24, posted a video outlining his planned attack before killing three coworkers at a Pennsylvania Weis supermarket on June 8, 2017. Investigators examined his online videos and journals. He died by suicide at the scene before police arrived.

item.title: How 50 Cent’s Diddy Feud Went From Diss Track To Netflix
item.description: 50 Cent’s rivalry with Sean “Diddy” Combs stretches back to a 2006 diss track and clashes over competing vodka brands. In 2025, he executive-produced Netflix’s Sean Combs: The Reckoning, examining allegations against his longtime rival. Combs’ team called it a “hit piece.”

item.title: Why Fans Linked Bieber’s ‘Yummy’ Video To Diddy
item.description: Justin Bieber’s “Yummy” video sparked theories that its white-clad guests referenced Sean “Diddy” Combs’ parties. That interpretation remains unsubstantiated. In May 2025, Bieber’s representative said he was not among Combs’ victims.

item.title: At 13, Genie Had Never Learned To Speak
item.description: Genie was discovered in California in 1970 after spending most of her childhood isolated and restrained inside a small room. With almost no normal social interaction or exposure to language, her case later became central to research on how and when humans learn to speak.

item.title: He Stayed Silent For Decades Until He Confronted His Abuser
item.description: Clark Fredericks said former Scout leader Dennis Pegg abused him for years as a child, trauma he kept hidden for decades. In 2012, Fredericks confronted and killed Pegg, later pleading guilty to manslaughter. After prison, he became an advocate for survivors of childhood abuse.
